snippet.title: Longplay of Rugrats: I Gotta Go Party
snippet.description:
Longplay of Rugrats: I Gotta Go Party, played as the NTSC version on the Game Boy Advance. This game's version was released on Nov. 8th, 2002. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

00:00​ - Start
01:55 - Cookie Catcher 
03:27 - Give Spike Food And Water 
04:55 - Keep The Babies Balanced
06:52 - Guide Spike Thru The Course
08:18 - Memory
09:42 - Catch The Bones
11:52 - Dig Battle
13:32 - Jigsaw Puzzle
14:56 - Worm Maze
16:18 - Outsmart Angelica
18:01 - Pick The Odd One Out
19:38 - Remove The Blocks
21:25 - Find The Characters
23:10 - Race The Other Reptars
26:03 - Phill's Pies
27:40 - Star Maze
29:21 - Match The Toy Box
30:46 - Rapids
33:40 - Jump The Toys
34:42 - Catch The Worms
36:15 - Find Spike's Missing Bones
38:26 - Collect The Most Cookies
39:30 - Match The Cards
40:49 - Unscramble The Picture
42:10 - End
42:25 - Credits

By: Terua
